beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:42.title: Senior Software Engineer - 99Pledges
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:42.description: ABOUT THE ROLE 99Pledges a fundraising technology platform that powers online donation campaigns for organizations, teams, and individuals through our flagship product and through white-label deployments for partners. We process real money at scale, so correctness, reliability, and security are core to everything we build. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in a mature, production Rails codebase, cares deeply about payment integrity, and can own features end-to-end from database schema to background jobs to the user-facing UI. ABOUT THE ROLE WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Core fundraising platform: Campaigns, participants, donations, and the reporting and metrics that fundraisers rely on. - Payment processing: Integrations with multiple payment providers (credit card, PayPal, and ACH/EFT), including automatic payouts, payment requests, and reconciliation. - Multi-tenant white-label system: Branding, feature flags, and configuration that let partners run the platform under their own identity. - Fraud prevention & trust: Fraud detection, device fingerprinting, and abuse mitigation that keep donors and organizations safe. - Background processing: Reliable email delivery, data exports, and scheduled metric calculations. TECH STACK - Backend: Ruby on Rails 7, Ruby 3.1 - Database: PostgreSQL (production), with careful attention to migrations and denormalized/calculated fields for performance - Frontend: HAML, SCSS, Bootstrap, jQuery - Background jobs: Delayed Job (Active Record backend) - Payments: Braintree, PayPal, Dwolla - Infrastructure: Heroku, AWS S3, Redis - Email: Postmark - Monitoring: Honeybadger (errors), New Relic (performance), Datadog (migrating to) - Analytics/experimentation: PostHog WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR REQUIRED - 3+ years building and maintaining production web applications, with strong Ruby on Rails experience. - Solid grasp of relational database design, query performance, and safe migrations against large production tables. - Experience integrating third-party APIs, ideally payment processors, and an appreciation for the failure modes that come with them (retries, idempotency, webhooks, reconciliation). - A test-first mindset, you write well-tested code and treat correctness and edge cases as first-class concerns. - Comfort working across the stack, including server-rendered views and front-end interactivity. - Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with payment/fintech systems, PCI considerations, or handling money in software. - Familiarity with multi-tenant / white-label architectures. - Experience with background job systems and asynchronous processing at scale. - Exposure to fraud detection or trust & safety systems. - Experience with feature flagging and A/B experimentation (e.g., PostHog). HOW WE WORK - We review designs before writing code and favor explicit, well-engineered solutions over clever ones. - We prefer DRY code, thorough testing, and small, reviewable changes. - We take production seriously: careful migrations, monitoring, and a bias toward correctness — because we handle donations that matter to real people and organizations. WHY JOIN US You'll work on software that helps organizations raise money for causes they care about, with a small team where your work has direct, visible impact on both the product and the people who depend on it. Our Values at Beacon Software - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworke

Strong written English skills and the ability to communicate actions using clear, simple, and consistent language. Ability to follow detailed guidelines precisely and apply the same rules consistently across a large volume of tasks. Strong accuracy and quality orientation, with the ability to achieve and maintain an 85–90%+ benchmark accuracy level. Ability to work efficiently toward productivity targets and complete a 1-minute video annotation workflow in approximately 4 minutes. Comfortable learning and using keyboard shortcuts and structured digital workflows. Ability to run background screen-recording software while completing assigned tasks. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8a5c8021-8362-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Network Engineer Senior/Principal based in United States. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced network security professional supporting large-scale enterprise environments. You will design, deploy, migrate, and operate modern network security services across cloud and on-premises infrastructure. The role offers hands-on exposure to next-generation firewalls, SASE/SSE, network visibility, and micro-segmentation technologies. You will play a key part in complex service transitions, phased migrations, infrastructure build-outs, and ongoing operations. Success requires strong technical judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams. You will also contribute to automation, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvements across a sophisticated security ecosystem. This role is well suited to a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges while supporting mission-critical environments. Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and enhance cloud and on-premises network security solutions, including Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama/Strata Cloud Manager, Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, Juniper SRX, F5, and supporting technologies. Maintain the security, integrity, and operational health of enterprise network security infrastructure and management platforms. Create and maintain technical documentation, including network diagrams, user guides, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks. Develop and support automation for configuration, validation, reporting, and other network engineering activities. Monitor existing and newly deployed environments, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to phased enterprise rollouts. Collaborate with engineering teams, internal stakeholders, and customer organizations to implement network security solutions and support infrastructure build-outs. Troubleshoot escalated issues, assess technical challenges, and provide recommendations and solutions that maintain service continuity. Contribute to technology evaluations and continuously strengthen expertise across enterprise network security platforms and emerging technologies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less-experienced engineers and professionals when appropriate. Coordinate hardware, software, and subcontractor requirements necessary to support network security deployments. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience with next-generation firewalls and enterprise network security technologies for Senior-level candidates, or 8+ years for Principal-level candidates. Strong technical knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, and network security architecture. Hands-on expertise with Palo Alto Networks technologies, including NGFW, Panorama/Strata Cloud Manager, Prisma Access, and GlobalProtect. Experience with Juniper SRX and F5 technologies, with exposure to Illumio, Gigamon, ExtraHop, and/or AlgoSec highly valuable. Experience working with SASE/SSE platforms, network visibility solutions, micro-segmentation technologies, or comparable enterprise security architectures. Ability to operate effectively in large, multi-tenant enterprise environments involving engineering, migration, and managed security operations. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with the flexibility to manage complex transition and operational challenges. Excellent written

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bbbb7273-4967-.title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bbbb7273-4967-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager based in United Kingdom. This is a commercially focused role for a digital marketing professional who can turn online visibility into measurable revenue growth. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Own the organic search strategy across SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation, and Generative Engine Optimisation, including keyword research, competitor analysis, technical optimisation, structured data, internal linking, content architecture, and search-intent analysis. Optimise product, category, service, and location-based pages to improve rankings and visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Develop commercially focused content around pricing, bulk purchasing, product comparisons, specifications, delivery information, and frequently asked questions. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Develop strategies to increase average order value, purchase frequency, and repeat revenue through bundles, volume offers, cross-selling, upselling, promotions, and abandoned-cart recovery. Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, display, and relevant Meta or LinkedIn channels. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. Build segmented email marketing and automated lifecycle campaigns covering new enquiries, quote follow-ups, abandoned carts, account applications, repeat-order reminders, customer reactivation, product launches, and promotions. Analyse campaign, CRM, website, and sales data to identify which marketing activities generate customers and revenue rather than relying on vanity metrics. Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering leads, quote requests, e-commerce sales, conversion rates, organic performance, advertising efficiency, average order value, repeat purchasing, and marketing-attributed revenue. Identify priority products, customer segments, and growth opportunities in collaboration with sales and management teams. Continuously test, measure, and refine marketing initiatives to improve commercial performance and establish clear attribution between digital activity and revenue

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f380ab12-fbc8-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f380ab12-fbc8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Croatia. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,
